book.title: Twenty Wishes (Blossom Street, #5)
book.description: Anne Marie Roche wants to find happiness again. At 38, her life is not what she'd expected. She's childless, recently widowed, alone. She starts a list of things she'd like to do. One of her wishes brings her into contact with Ellen, an eight-year-old girl. The relationship that develops is far more involving than Anne Marie could have imagined.
